# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

payload.focus: Tanya's Sprint Retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly references the Zephyr integration as the key unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock), the async decision widget shipping (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture), and velocity of 23 points (Obs_TinaVelocity). The document extends the core narratives — DecisionCaptureAtConsensus and DecisionsEvaporate — that the widget embodies, and sits under the AntiSlackPositioning umbrella. I expanded the prior Sprint 4 retro observations (Obs_TinaVelocity, Obs_TanyaThesisProven, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved) so the passes can detect whether this is a duplicate or a later retro extending the same claims. Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint is included because this retro may update the next-sprint focus. Pricing, product category, and target market positions are surfaced as context the retro could implicitly confirm or revise. I did not expand StyleMetrics_Sprint4Retro as it is stylistic metadata not load-bearing for this document's concepts.

positions.name: Sprint4SuccessEvidenceReport
positions.frame: what evidence does this retro offer that the sprint delivered measurable product success?
positions.why: All three expressions are flat, unhedged past-tense assertions (conviction: claim throughout, temporal: past/realis/concrete throughout) reporting concrete pieces of the same sprint outcome — a shipped artifact, a quantified velocity result, and a causal attribution for that result. Read together they form a single evidentiary report of the sprint's success rather than three unrelated facts; the register stays matter-of-fact even on the superlative claim, so the group coheres as understated substantiation rather than celebratory narrative.

placements.why: Shipping the async decision widget is the literal instantiation of this leaf's theme — Tina's insight that decisions must be captured at the moment of consensus and linked to context, with zero extra steps. The shipping fact is evidence the mechanism moved from vision to delivered feature; it doesn't name a new subject, it confirms this one, so it joins the existing leaf's support rather than minting.

Naming the Zephyr integration as 'the key unlock' asserts a recurring, generalizable claim — that cross-platform integration architecture, not the capture UX alone, is what determines delivery speed — a subject future sprints will keep feeding as new integrations ship. This specializes rather than restates Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus's 'zero extra steps' framing by naming the technical lever behind it, so it extends that leaf rather than duplicating it. The 23-point velocity figure is not itself leaf-grain (a bare metric per the grain test) — it is evidence of the unlock's impact, so it joins this leaf's support rather than minting its own.
placements.title: Platform-integration architecture is the lever that removes capture friction
placements.frame: What integration or embedding capability removed friction this cycle, and what delivery outcome (velocity, adoption, retention) did it unlock?
